region: Sri Lanka — Dry & Intermediate Zones (Demonstration Focus: Anuradhapura / Matale)

sources.notes: Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, Rice Research and Development Institute (RRDI Bathalagoda). Seasonal water requirement for lowland puddle rice averages 900-1250 mm. Lowland Low Humic Gley (LHG) and alluvial soils across Dry and Intermediate Zones (Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Matale). Limitation: Cultivation in Yala requires secure major irrigation tank storage; during water deficits, pulses/OFCs are prioritized over double-cropped rice.

Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, Field Crops Research and Development Institute (FCRDI Mahailluppallama). Short-duration pulse (60-65 days) with seasonal water demand 300-400 mm. Highly recommended for Yala in rice fallows on residual moisture and well-drained Reddish Brown Earths (RBE). Assumption: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen via Rhizobium; requires well-drained conditions and fails in stagnant waterlogging.

Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, FCRDI Mahailluppallama. Crop cycle 105-115 days. Water requirement estimated at 500-650 mm. Suited for upland well-drained RBE soils in Dry and Intermediate Zones (Anuradhapura, Matale upland). Limitation: Sensitive to waterlogging at germination and vegetative phases; high nitrogen demand.

Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, FCRDI Mahailluppallama. Crop duration 90-105 days. Estimated water requirement 450-600 mm. Thrives in sandy loams and light-textured RBEs. Moderate drought tolerance. Limitation: Sensitive to heavy clays and poor drainage; harvesting is impeded in hard-setting soils.

Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, FCRDI Mahailluppallama. Duration 70-80 days. Water requirement 300-400 mm. Highly drought resilient; well-suited for late Maha and Yala rainfed or semi-irrigated upland fields across Anuradhapura and Matale dry belts. Effective green manure and nitrogen fixer.

Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, FCRDI Mahailluppallama. Traditional hardy coarse grain. Duration 75-90 days. Estimated water demand 300-450 mm. Exceptional drought tolerance on marginal and upland soils in Sri Lanka Dry Zone. Low fertilizer requirement; useful for climate risk mitigation.

Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, FCRDI Mahailluppallama. Duration 70-80 days. Water demand 300-400 mm. Traditional pulse cultivated extensively in Dry Zone rice-fallow systems during Yala. Excellent biological nitrogen fixation and soil health benefits.

Department of Agriculture Sri Lanka, FCRDI Mahailluppallama. Duration 120-150 days. Water requirement 500-700 mm. High-value cash crop suited for well-drained RBE soils in Dry and Intermediate Zones. Highly susceptible to viral leaf curl complex and anthracnose; strictly requires rotation away from Solanaceae.
